  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  FEBRUARY 25, 2020

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 4:31p.m., on
  Tuesday, February 25, 2020, at Civic Center- East Wing, 1855 Main Street.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Ted Winterer (arrived at 4:33 p.m.)

  Absent:  Councilmember Morena

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:31 p.m., with all
  members present, except Councilmembers Winterer and Morena.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment.
  Councilmember Winterer
  arrived at 4:33 p.m.  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:32 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 5:30 p.m., with all members present, except
  Councilmember Morena, to report the following:

  1.A.  Public Employee Evaluation:
  Title: City Clerk

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard, with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:31 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Kevin McKeown
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  February 25, 2020
